# Surgical

This folder catalogs specific open surgical procedures tracked and benchmarked within the Danish healthcare system. It currently contains the entity for open surgery, which is systematically quantified in the Acute Surgery Database and compared against minimally invasive techniques to evaluate regional treatment patterns and guide clinical decision-making.
